description: Sourcing Manager - Stitched Items in an apparel, made-ups and home furnishing industry is primarily concerned with procurement of fabrics, trims and accessories as per design needs and/or as per sample requirements received from merchandiser. The role is supervising the functionary of purchase departments. He/she is concerned with identifying suitable suppliers for materials assessed on the basis of price, quality, reliability, time and long-term business relations. He/ She must supervise all negotiations and prepare appropriate documents for same
awardingBodyName: Apparel Madeups and Home Furnishings Sector Skill Council
typeOfQualification: General, For ToT, For ToA, Fresh Skilling

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Maintain health, safety and security in the sourcing department with Gender and PwD Sensitization
Maintain records about procurement of materials
Supervise and evaluate performance of subordinates
Procure materials from national and international suppliers related to fabrics, trims and accessories
Plan for the procurement of materials as per garment design requirements
Ensure adherence to industry, regulatory, and organizational standards, while incorporating the principles of environmental sustainability

eligibilityCriteriaGrid.PREVNSQFLEVELSACHIEVED: Previous relevant Qualification of NSQF Level 5.5
